character: Two towns sharing five ski mountains in Graubünden: Parsenn (the largest, linking Davos and Klosters below the Weissfluhgipfel, 2,844 m), Jakobshorn, Madrisa, Rinerhorn and Pischa. Parsenn is known for long runs down towards the Prättigau valley (reference).
learning: Reference note: ski schools operate in Davos and Klosters. Confirm beginner areas (Madrisa and Rinerhorn are often suggested — unverified).
